why: The answer depends on pairing each metallurgical operation with what it achieves - cyanide leaching for Au, froth floatation to concentrate the sulphide ZnS, electrolytic reduction of molten alumina for Al, and zone refining for ultrapure Ge.
note: Topic gap, not a chapter gap: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Elements carries exactly one topic row, 'Extraction of Copper', which none of the four matched operations is about, and there is no 'Unspecified Topic' placeholder to fall back on. Rows the chapter needs: 'Concentration of Ores (Froth Floatation, Magnetic Separation, Leaching)', 'Reduction of Metal Oxides and Thermodynamics of Extraction (Ellingham Diagram)', 'Refining of Metals (Zone Refining, Electrolytic, Vapour Phase, Van Arkel)', 'Extraction of Aluminium, Iron and Zinc'.
proposed_topic: Refining of Metals (Zone Refining, Electrolytic and Vapour Phase Refining)
